title: The d+1-round dCUFN-SP active-S-box conjecture
summary: Determine whether every d+1-round window of a d-branch contracting unbalanced Feistel network satisfies the conjectured lower bound on differentially active S-boxes.

formal_statement.body: For a d-branch dCUFN-SP with m cells per branch, determine whether every $d+1$ consecutive rounds contain at least $(d-1)(m+1)$ differentially active S-boxes under the source ODM restrictions.

scope.domain: Active-S-box bounds in contracting unbalanced Feistel networks
assumptions: Contracting MDS diffusion and ODM restrictions
scope.unresolved_remainder: This record is the thesis d+1-round statement and must not be conflated with the DCC 2(d+1)-round proposition or its separate d>4 extension.

citations.label: Bogdanov, Analysis and Design of Block Cipher Constructions
Bogdanov, On unbalanced Feistel networks with contracting MDS diffusion

progress.summary: The thesis states the stronger d+1-round lower-bound conjecture after the proved DCC proposition.
